title: type.list, contract version 1
description: The editor descriptors of every type of the installation (PRD 11.12, 14.1): what the panel's forms render each type from. The document carries nothing: every actor may run it without a permission, because it tells an actor only the shape of the types, filtered to what the actor may read, while the anonymous principal may not. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Schema\Domain\Queries\ListTypes, and the generated codec reads it and writes its canonical JSON: an object without members. Its result is type.list.result.v1.json.
